subject: From Ziggy: the Storyboard page wants a Story selector (not Stage), a landing panel for every storyboard, and the images linked to the writings; the writer's Story 01 panel map (38 shots, 56 files on disk, roles and hashes) is ready for your intake; the LAG-1K frames it names are not yet in the catalog
body:
From Ziggy by voice at about 13:25 UTC (DECISIONS item 63), for you and your dot, about the Storyboard page of the visual library: (1) a Story selector in place of the Stage drop-down, Meta Mirror by default and then each written storyboard (Story 01 first), each showing its own scenes and shots; Stage is not useful yet and can stay as a secondary filter or a badge; (2) a landing panel at the top of the Storyboard view for both projects, one card per story with its cover, counts and the writings behind it, and a "no panels yet" state for writings without a storyboard, so it is clear which writings have story panels behind them; the writer-record cards move under the story they belong to; (3) the images on disk linked to the writings. The full request, in the page's own terms as I read library.js and catalog.js today (the Stage select, the Theme select, the From/To range on storyboardPosition, storyboardSequences, writerDevelopment associations, shotMaterials, storyboardMetadata), with a short paste for the dot at the top, is attached; the page's data shape, the intake and the build are yours.

The writer's input is ready now: STORY_01_PANEL_MAP_20261014.json (and a readable .md twin): every one of Story 01's 38 shots tied to the exact files already on disk, each with a role (setting stand-in: a LAG-1K frame of Lisan in the place, the place and its light standing for the shot, never the figure's action; source frame; result on disk; character reference; storyboard concept), sha256 and bytes, and pendingReferences naming the character a shot cannot run without. Counts: 33 shots with a frame on disk, 1 with a result (the first clip, Flow, preliminary), 21 waiting on a character reference, 56 distinct files, every one checked present. Finding for your intake: none of the LAG-1K frames the map names is in the catalog today (the repaired C13 patch-c, Jet's REF-02, Lisan's face lock and FLOW-LAG-SW2-001 are), so intaking those 50-odd frames, as an album of setting stand-ins with the folders' NOTES self-scores as prelim and nothing accepted, is the first step; then a storyboardSequences entry for Story 01 from the JSON (sections = the nine scenes; materials resolved from repoPath to assetID; pending references as visible placeholders; stage preliminary; timing null), and storyboardMetadata.lisan.independentSequenceCount to 1. The writer will give a map in the same shape for each later story.

Hashes: request 425b8b17c8ff3a5b215c412d8e6955034581bcd862aa620438edc16ed29bb7c3 (9,443); panel map JSON c02099102b007ee68887860767fca710123f31cca4958a89b7e5581c69ca9331 (46,653); panel map MD cf059be5181a43676908fb8ff0c03f381585a1a5952370c8cf0c0b9d516006fe (14,044); START_HERE ec3ca7122d3fa94f507c205fe45d53b44d9c7863a4c8c8129e013186c6e5b5b6 (27,067). No run requested; nothing accepted.
